name: 6-MeO-THH
summary: 6-MeO-THH, also known as 6-methoxy-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroharman, is a β-carboline (or more specifically a pinoline) derivative and a structural isomer of tetrahydroharmine (7-MeO-THH). It is mentioned in Alexander Shulgin's book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), stating that 6-MeO-THH is very similar to the other carbolines. The compound has been isolated from certain plants of the Virola family.

pharmacology.text: Very little is known about the psychoactivity of 6-MeO-THH in humans. Studies in rats have shown it to bind to a number of serotonin 5-HT1 receptors and 5-HT2 receptors, dopamine D2 receptors, benzodiazepine receptors, and imidazoline receptors.

uses.text: 6-MeO-THH is reported to be hallucinogenic similarly to other β-carbolines like harmaline.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. β-Carbolines such as harmaline can cause nausea, vomiting, dizziness, tremor and a drop in blood pressure. Some also block monoamine oxidase, which raises the risk of serotonin syndrome and dangerous blood pressure rises.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。像駱駝蓬鹼這類β-咔啉可能引起噁心、嘔吐、頭暈、顫抖與血壓下降。其中有些還會抑制單胺氧化酶，使血清素症候群與血壓危險升高的風險增加。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。像骆驼蓬碱这类β-咔啉可能引起恶心、呕吐、头晕、颤抖与血压下降。其中有些还会抑制单胺氧化酶，使血清素症候群与血压危险升高的风险增加。

fact.en: It is a β-carboline, the same family as harmaline from Syrian rue and as pinoline, a compound reported in the pineal gland. These rings form naturally when a tryptamine joins with a simple aldehyde.
fact.zh: 它屬於β-咔啉家族，與敘利亞芸香中的駱駝蓬鹼（harmaline），以及據報存在於松果體的pinoline同屬一類。當色胺與簡單的醛結合時，自然就會形成這類環。
fact.zhHans: 它属于β-咔啉家族，与叙利亚芸香中的骆驼蓬碱（harmaline），以及据报存在于松果体的pinoline同属一类。当色胺与简单的醛结合时，自然就会形成这类环。
